outlets.name: VisitPA (Pennsylvania Tourism Office)
outlets.credible: Official Pennsylvania state tourism office; fact-checked destination listings.

outlets.name: Visit Edinboro / Edinboro Community Economic Development (ECED)
outlets.credible: Edinboro's community economic-development and tourism body; local business directory of record for the town.

outlets.name: The Business Journal (Youngstown / Mahoning Valley)
outlets.credible: Long-running regional business-news publication covering NW PA / NE Ohio; original reported feature on Big Rail Brewing.

outlets.name: Western Pennsylvania Conservancy
outlets.credible: Owner/manager of the Wolf Creek Narrows preserve (and historic steward of McConnells Mill, Moraine, Ohiopyle); authoritative on its own natural areas.

outlets.name: Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
outlets.credible: Pittsburgh's paper of record; original recreation feature on Wolf Creek Narrows.

outlets.name: Roadside America
outlets.credible: Long-established editorial catalog of American roadside attractions; used only as a secondary source alongside UncoveringPA + VisitCrawford for the Linesville Spillway.

outlets.name: NextPittsburgh
outlets.credible: Established Pittsburgh-region news and features site; Butler County brewery roundup.

outlets.name: The Clio
outlets.credible: Curated, sourced encyclopedia of historic/cultural sites; used as a secondary source alongside SRU + Experience Butler for the Old Stone House.

outlets.name: Slippery Rock University (official)
outlets.credible: Owner and operator of the Old Stone House museum; primary institutional source.

outlets.name: ArbNet / Morton Register of Arboreta
outlets.credible: Morton Arboretum's arboretum-accreditation program; authoritative record that Goodell Gardens is an accredited arboretum.

outlets.name: Butler Eagle
outlets.credible: Butler County's daily newspaper of record; local reporting on the Passavant House.
